genxml.title: RE3 raster engine: host-visible register banks
genxml.from: NetBSD sgimips public driver memory map comment
genxml.doc: Host window of the RE3 raster engine in the Express graphics slot. Only the three banks that a public driver comment names are listed; their contents are unknown. Provenance tags in item text: [public] published document or public driver, [binary] shipped binary, [vendor-derived] upstream headers (none used). See the unit README.

struct.name: BANK_27BIT
struct.from: NetBSD sgimips public driver memory map comment
struct.doc: First word of the bank [public] a public driver's memory map calls the 27-bit registers. Extent, register names and reset values unknown. No shipped program read (PROM, kernel driver, GL core, X driver, diagnostic program) accesses this bank [binary, negative search, inferred]. qtest: none can be written until a source gives the layout; the first test is that an access does not fault.
